articles.title: Crypto trading app Fomo raises $75 million at $550 million valuation in Index Ventures-led Series B
articles.summary: Fomo raised a $75 million Series B round at a $550 million valuation led by Index Ventures, Fortune reported.

articles.title: MoneyGram becomes Solana validator, expands blockchain payments strategy
articles.summary: Solana is now the third blockchain where MoneyGram operates an official validator, alongside Tempo and the Midnight Network.

articles.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 520 BTC for $35 million, adds to USD reserve despite STRC slide
articles.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for more than 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth around $55 billion.

articles.title: ‘Between supportive and restrictive forces’: Bitcoin stalls near $64,000 as Fed rate-hike risk overshadows Iran ceasefire relief
articles.summary: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as six weeks of ETF outflows, and a hawkish Fed overshadow the U.S.-Iran peace deal.

articles.title: Bank of England drops proposed holding caps for sterling stablecoins, sets £40 billion issuance guardrail
articles.summary: The Bank of England proposed a £40 billion systemic stablecoin issuance guardrail and revised backing assets, targeting a 2027 launch.

articles.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs log sixth consecutive week of net outflows; analyst says selling wave is exhausting itself
articles.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $227 million in net outflows last week, extending the negative flow streak to six consecutive weeks.

articles.title: Bank of Korea advances CBDC deposit token initiative to test real-world usage: report
articles.summary: South Korea's CBDC pilot project is entering its second phase, where deposit tokens will be integrated into existing banking systems.

articles.title: Ethereum ‘tax’ debate erupts over proposal to redirect portion of staking rewards to ecosystem funding
articles.summary: A post on the Ethereum Research forum proposes letting validators vote to redirect up to 10% of staking rewards to fund public goods.

articles.title: Bitget enables direct US stock purchases using crypto
articles.summary: Bitget launched Stock+, enabling crypto-funded purchases of full and fractional US stocks through regulated brokers.

articles.title: How Does Tether Make Money? Understanding the Business Model Behind USDT
articles.summary: Tether primarily makes money by earning interest on the reserve assets that back USDT, the world’s largest stablecoin. When USDT is minted, Tether receives dollars or equivalent assets and invests most of those reserves in short-term U.S. Treasury bills and other low-risk instruments. The yield generated by those reserves is the core source of Tether’s […]

articles.title: South Korea’s Toss Bank to test blockchain-based financial infrastructure on Solana
articles.summary: Toss Bank and Solana will work on a proof-of-concept for overseas remittances and payments involving stablecoins.

articles.title: Japan’s corporate pension fund plans to allocate 1% of assets to crypto: reports
articles.summary: The National Business Corporate Pension Fund plans to allocate roughly 1% of its assets to crypto, according to Coinpost.

articles.title: Ethereum Layer 2 Taiko halts block production following exploit; urges users to withdraw funds
articles.summary: Onchain security firm Blockaid said the root cause of the exploit could be a flaw in Taiko bridge's source-signal proof validation.

articles.title: Altura winds down stablecoin vault after ‘unprecedented level’ of withdrawal requests
articles.summary: Altura's CEO said market speculation played a part, seemingly referring to contagion fears linked to the depegging of Main Street's msUSD.

articles.title: Polymarket paid creators to stage fake winning bets on dummy sites: WSJ
articles.summary: The Journal reviewed more than 1,100 videos and found none of the roughly $1.9 million in bets shown in influencer-produced hype videos were real.

articles.title: Fentanyl-linked Chinese network tied to crypto fraud from Japan involving fake ‘Zksync.jp’ token: Nikkei
articles.summary: The linked criminal group allegedly distributed a scam token under the name "zksync.jp" to deceive crypto users worldwide, with losses of over $1 million.

articles.title: Notorious ‘jaredfromsubway’ MEV bot drained for roughly $7.5 million in counter-MEV honeypot
articles.summary: An X account using the bot's name claimed a $15 million loss and offered a $1 million bounty, but evidence shows it is a likely impersonator.

articles.title: Secret Network’s Axelar bridge drained for $4.67 million in infinite-mint exploit that went unnoticed for seven days
articles.summary: Secret Network says about $770,000 of the stolen funds still sits in the attacker's Axelar wallet, and that Axelar declined its request to freeze it.

articles.title: Charles Schwab is working with Cboe to launch S&P 500 ‘yes-or-no’ binary options contracts: WSJ
articles.summary: The binary contracts would mark the brokerage's first move into prediction-market-style products, a sector that Kalshi and Polymarket already dominate.

articles.title: Andre Cronje, two others resign from Sonic Labs board as S token trades 97% below its peak
articles.summary: Sonic Labs said the three "remain invested in Sonic's success" but will no longer make business decisions for the Layer 1 network, formerly Fantom.
